callees.name: _load_sidecar_json
callees.pre_condition: file_path is a string path to an existing file; suffix is either ".spec.json" or ".info.json"
callees.post_condition: Returns the parsed JSON dict from the sidecar file at <file_path><suffix>, or None if the sidecar file does not exist or contains data that cannot be parsed as valid JSON

callees.name: format_spec_for_reasoner
callees.pre_condition: spec is a dict with keys "signature", "pre_condition", and "post_condition", each mapping to a string value
callees.post_condition: Returns a multi-line string containing the signature on the first line, followed by a blank line, then the pre-condition text labeled "Pre-condition:", a blank line, and the post-condition text labeled "Post-condition:"

callees.name: format_info_for_reasoner
callees.pre_condition: info is a dict with a "callees" key whose value is a list of callee entry dicts, each with string-typed keys "name", "signature", "pre_condition", and "post_condition"
callees.post_condition: Returns a FunctionSpecMap where each callee is stored as an entry whose key is the callee name, value is the callee's formatted pre-condition and post-condition text, and the signatures dict maps callee name to signature string

callees.name: _remove_func_comments
callees.pre_condition: code is a string containing source code possibly containing comments
callees.post_condition: Returns the code string with all block comments and line comments removed, while preserving all content that appears inside string literals (single-quoted and double-quoted)

callees.name: FunctionSpecMap
callees.post_condition: Returns a new FunctionSpecMap instance with no entries and an empty signatures dict
